source.heading: 2.5.5 Poisons and Diseases

diseases.name: Grave Rot
diseases.text: A black rot from the bite of the corpse-eating dead. It saps the body's strength night after night.

diseases.name: Swamp Fever
diseases.text: A shaking fever caught from the bad air and biting flies of the marshes. The sick fight and work poorly until it breaks.

diseases.name: Pit Flux
diseases.text: A bloody flux bred in filth and standing water. It wrings the sick out each night.
